title: PATCH /api/tasks/[id] randomly fails with a 500, so a toggle click is sometimes a no-op
summary: The PATCH handler returns 500 about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5) before toggling the task, so a checkbox click silently fails intermittently and the active counter never drops. The spec and the rest of the app logic are correct; the failure is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.
